department: Biology (Graduate School of Science and Engineering)

deadline.value: No fixed deadline: the Graduate School of Science and Engineering admits PhD candidates on a rolling basis once a supervisor and funding are in place.
deadline.quote: does not have fixed application deadlines, but rather works on a 'rolling admission' system

also.quote: If students have obtained funding, received explicit support from a prospective supervisor, and meet the admission requirements they will be admitted to the PhD programme

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Applicants need explicit support from a prospective supervisor; open applications are not accepted.
supervisor.quote: The GSSE does not accept 'open' applications from candidates who have not yet received explicit support from a prospective supervisor

also.quote: Applications are prepared by the research institute of the prospective supervisor

funding.value: Candidates must secure their own means of support before admission (a UG salary position, a scholarship or other funding); the page does not say how many students are funded.

entry_route.value: Direct admission needs an internationally recognized Master's degree in the relevant field; others are assessed by the GSSE Admissions Board.
entry_route.quote: an internationally recognized Master’s degree in the relevant field

also.quote: PhD candidates who do not meet the admission requirements are formally assessed by the GSSE Admissions Board

notes: Built from the Graduate School of Science and Engineering rules, which apply to every GSSE PhD candidate. No department PhD page was fetched in budget. Listed as a GSSE research programme on the official PhD research programmes page.
